name: rsi-loop
description: AIDE²-style recursive self-improvement loop for Claude Code. Bi-level optimization where an outer-loop agent iteratively rewrites an inner tree-search research agent, selected on private held-out scores under a fixed budget across a heterogeneous task battery (optimization, ML engineering, harness engineering). Standalone /rsi:autoresearch solves tasks by tree search; /rsi:init + /rsi:step + /rsi:run drive the outer loop. See docs/PLAN.md.
